# @dxtmisha/scripts

> CLI tools, AI integration scripts, and automation utilities for the DXT UI ecosystem.

Provides automated Vue component scaffolding, Figma layout synchronization, library packaging, documentation generation via AI (Gemini, Claude, OpenAI), visual regression screenshot capturing, and prompt builders.

## CLI Commands & Binaries

- [dxt-component](bin/design-component.ts): Scaffolds complete Vue component directory structure (`.vue`, `props.ts`, `styleToken.scss`, and exports).
- [dxt-component-wiki](bin/design-component-wiki.ts): Generates Storybook and MDX wiki documentation for components.
- [dxt-constructor](bin/design-constructor.ts): Builds and links component constructors.
- [dxt-library](bin/design-library.ts): Automatically generates `library.ts` barrel files across packages.
- [dxt-ui](bin/design-ui.ts): Full UI component and documentation rebuild pipeline.
- [dxt-figma-layout](bin/design-figma.ts): Synchronizes Figma layout tokens with code.
- [dxt-flags](bin/design-flags.ts): Rebuilds SVG flag assets and country dataset.
- [dxt-prompt](bin/design-prompt.ts): Generates consolidated `ai-prompt.md` files for AI coding assistants.
- [dxt-screenshot](bin/design-screenshot.ts): Puppeteer-based automated component screenshot capture across themes.
- [dxt-types / dxt-types-save](bin/design-types.ts): Generates AI-optimized `ai-types.md` technical references.
